title: DocArchiveAcceptVersionRequest v1
description: POST /document-archive/documents/{documentId}/versions/{seq}/accept request body. `clientRequestToken` is the idempotency key checked BEFORE any state-transition validation (D-143 Decision 2/Bloqueador 4-5), never optional — a caller that omits it gets no idempotency guarantee at all for the single most destructive operation in this module.
